paper_title: Broadcast and Minimum Spanning Tree with o(m) Messages in the Asynchronous CONGEST Model
statement: We presented the first asynchronous algorithm for computing the MST in the CONGEST model with Õ(n3/2 ) communication when nodes have initial knowledge of their neighbors’ identities. This shows that the KT1 model is significantly more communication efficient than KT0 even in the asynchronous model. Open problems that are raised by these results are: (1) Does the asynchronous KT1 model require substantially more communication that the synchronous KT1 model? (2) Can we improve the time complexity of the algorithm while maintaining the message complexity?
